partition.krs-grammar-partition:
KRS-PART-SYNTAX (program syntax)
  sort Exp
  sort Value
  subsort Value ::= Int
  subsort Exp ::= Value
  subsort Value ::= Bool
  production ExpSyntax::And
  production ExpSyntax::Neg
KRS-PART (pub productions that are not program syntax)
  (none)
partition.krs-grammar-kevm-case:
KRS-EVM-SYNTAX (program syntax)
  sort Command
  sort LogEntry
  production Commands::Done
  production Commands::Emit
KRS-EVM (pub productions that are not program syntax)
  production BlockHashLookup: argument `hashes: List`: K has no LIST-SYNTAX module
  production LogRecord::Entry: argument `topics: List`: K has no LIST-SYNTAX module
partition.krs-grammar-program-warning:
KRS-PROGRAM-WARNING-SYNTAX (program syntax)
  sort LogEntry
KRS-PROGRAM-WARNING (pub productions that are not program syntax)
  production LogRecord::Entry: argument `topics: List`: K has no LIST-SYNTAX module

krs-grammar-program-warning: warning[krs::partition::not-program-syntax]: `LogRecord::Entry` is marked `program` but its field `topics: List` needs K's LIST module, which has no -SYNTAX variant; it is placed in KRS-PROGRAM-WARNING and programs cannot contain it

removed-root: error[krs::plan::removed-facet-key]: could not plan collector: package `krs-grammar-removed-root` definition `main` sets `root`: the key was removed; program syntax is now `pub` minus `internal`
removed-syntax-root: error[krs::plan::removed-facet-key]: could not plan collector: package `krs-grammar-removed-syntax-root` definition `main` sets `syntax-root`: the key was removed; program syntax is now `pub` minus `internal`
invalid-int-literals: error[krs::plan::invalid-int-literals]: could not plan collector: package `krs-grammar-invalid-int-literals` sets `int-literals = "natural"`; expected "signed" (the default, INT-SYNTAX) or "unsigned" (UNSIGNED-INT-SYNTAX)
internal-not-pub: error[krs::rust-expansion::uncoded-error]: `internal` applies only to a `pub` production; non-pub productions are already private
mixed-group: error[krs::partition::mixed-group]: group `ops_tier0` mixes `internal` production `Ops::Hidden` with program-syntax production `Ops::Visible`; K priorities and associativity apply per module, so mark both `internal` or neither
signed-leak: error[krs::partition::signed-integer-leak]: `KRS-UNSIGNED-ROOT-SYNTAX` uses `int-literals = "unsigned"` but imports `KRS-SIGNED-BASE-SYNTAX`, whose signed INT-SYNTAX literals would leak into programs (K imports are unions)
